primary_anchor_zh: 中央低茶桌、沿墙坐垫区和后方木屏风所构成的整体布局
story_reason_zh: 茶室格屏为隔开庭院而缓慢合拢，随后重新打开

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 整间茶室在暖色木质茶室，保持安静稳定，仅屏风旁薄帘轻微移动。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 保持安静稳定，仅屏风旁薄帘轻微移动
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 中央低茶桌、沿墙坐垫区和后方木屏风所构成的整体布局占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 宽大的木格屏风缓慢合拢并遮住茶室，画面只留下石庭院
shot_design.main_action_zh: 宽大的木格屏风缓慢合拢并遮住茶室，画面只留下石庭院
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 门、屏风或入口帘的开合符合场景用途，动作缓慢，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 茶室外相邻的空石庭院

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 木格屏风缓慢打开，重新露出完整茶室布局
shot_design.main_action_zh: 木格屏风缓慢打开，重新露出完整茶室布局
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新展示中央低茶桌、沿墙坐垫区和后方木屏风所构成的整体布局，以整体空间关系作为唯一验收目标。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames a low tea table at the center, a cushion area along the wall, and a wooden screen at the rear inside a warm timber tea room. A thin curtain beside the screen moves gently.

A fixed wide shot looks through an open entrance onto a low tea table at the center, a cushion area along the wall, and a wooden screen at the rear inside a warm timber tea room. A broad wooden lattice screen slowly closes across the entrance until the room is fully hidden, leaving only the empty stone courtyard in view.

A fixed wide shot holds on the empty stone courtyard. A broad wooden lattice screen slowly opens, revealing a low tea table at the center, a cushion area along the wall, and a wooden screen at the rear inside a warm timber tea room.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 宽大的木格屏风缓慢合拢并遮住茶室，画面只留下石庭院
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 茶室外相邻的空石庭院
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 木格屏风缓慢打开，重新露出完整茶室布局
transition_design.design_note_zh: Scene/layout 无法自行离场，因此 Shot 2 用自然遮挡结构缓慢关闭，Shot 3 用对应开启动作重新露出整体布局。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
